tool_schemas.name: get_daily_challenge
tool_schemas.description: Returns the Daily Challenge for the given ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or, if omitted, for today, including the full cached problem payload (titleSlug, description, constraints, examples, and related metadata). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if date is not a valid YYYY-MM-DD, NOT_FOUND if no daily challenge is available for that date in the cache, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request rate limits are exceeded.

date.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to fetch the Daily Challenge for; defaults to today if omitted.

tool_schemas.name: get_problem
tool_schemas.description: Returns the cached metadata and full content for the problem identified by titleSlug (including description, examples, constraints, and associated fields). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if titleSlug is missing or empty, NOT_FOUND if the slug does not match any cached problem, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request rate limits are exceeded.

titleSlug.description: The URL slug/identifier of the problem (e.g., 'two-sum', 'add-two-numbers') as it appears in the LeetCode URL

tool_schemas.name: search_problems
tool_schemas.description: Searches cached problems using the provided filters (category, tags, difficulty, and searchKeywords) and returns a page of results ordered by the service’s default ranking; pagination is offset/limit where offset is the number of items to skip and limit is the maximum items returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any enum value is invalid, if limit is not a positive number, or if offset is negative, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request rate limits are exceeded.

category.description: Problem category filter (e.g., 'algorithms', 'database', 'shell') to narrow down the problem domain

tags.description: List of topic tags to filter problems by (e.g., ['array', 'dynamic-programming', 'tree'])

difficulty.description: Problem difficulty level filter to show only problems of a specific difficulty

searchKeywords.description: Keywords to search in problem titles and descriptions

limit.description: Maximum number of problems to return in a single request (for pagination)

offset.description: Number of problems to skip (for pagination)

tool_schemas.name: get_user_profile
tool_schemas.description: Returns the cached LeetCode user profile for username, including profile fields and aggregated stats as available from the upstream read APIs. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if username is missing or empty, NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist or is not retrievable, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request rate limits are exceeded.

username.description: LeetCode username to retrieve profile information for

tool_schemas.name: get_recent_submissions
tool_schemas.description: Returns up to limit of the user’s most recent submissions (accepted and non-accepted) with the available submission metadata; results are returned in recency order and are limited to the most recent items only (no paging beyond limit). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if username is missing/empty or limit is not a positive number, NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist or submissions are unavailable, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request rate limits are exceeded.

username.description: LeetCode username to retrieve recent submissions for

limit.description: Maximum number of submissions to return (optional, defaults to server-defined limit)

tool_schemas.name: get_recent_ac_submissions
tool_schemas.description: Returns up to limit of the user’s most recent accepted (AC) submissions with the available submission metadata; results are returned in recency order and are limited to the most recent items only (no paging beyond limit). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if username is missing/empty or limit is not a positive number, NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist or accepted submissions are unavailable, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request rate limits are exceeded.

username.description: LeetCode username to retrieve recent accepted submissions for

limit.description: Maximum number of accepted submissions to return (optional, defaults to server-defined limit)

tool_schemas.name: get_user_contest_ranking
tool_schemas.description: Returns contest ranking and performance data for username, optionally restricting history to only contests the user attended when attended=true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if username is missing/empty, NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist or contest data is unavailable, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request rate limits are exceeded.

username.description: LeetCode username to retrieve contest ranking information for

attended.description: Whether to include only the contests the user has participated in (true) or all contests (false); defaults to true

tool_schemas.name: list_problem_solutions
tool_schemas.description: Lists community solution topics for questionSlug and returns solution metadata (including topicId) rather than full article content; results are paged with skip/limit and can be sorted by orderBy and filtered by userInput and tagSlugs. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if questionSlug is missing/empty, if limit is not a positive number, if skip is negative, or if orderBy is not one of the supported values, NOT_FOUND if the problem slug has no indexed solutions, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request rate limits are exceeded.

questionSlug.description: The URL slug/identifier of the problem to retrieve solutions for (e.g., 'two-sum', 'add-two-numbers'). This is the same string that appears in the LeetCode problem URL after '/problems/'

limit.description: Maximum number of solutions to return per request. Used for pagination and controlling response size. Default is 20 if not specified. Must be a positive integer.

skip.description: Number of solutions to skip before starting to collect results. Used in conjunction with 'limit' for implementing pagination. Default is 0 if not specified. Must be a non-negative integer.

orderBy.description: Sorting criteria for the returned solutions. 'DEFAULT' sorts by LeetCode's default algorithm (typically a combination of recency and popularity), 'MOST_VOTES' sorts by the number of upvotes (highest first), and 'MOST_RECENT' sorts by publication date (newest first).

userInput.description: Search term to filter solutions by title, content, or author name. Case insensitive. Useful for finding specific approaches or algorithms mentioned in solutions.

tagSlugs.description: Array of tag identifiers to filter solutions by programming languages (e.g., 'python', 'java') or problem algorithm/data-structure tags (e.g., 'dynamic-programming', 'recursion'). Only solutions tagged with at least one of the specified tags will be returned.

tool_schemas.name: get_problem_solution
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full solution article for topicId, including complete body content and associated metadata (author and navigation fields when available). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if topicId is missing or empty, NOT_FOUND if the topicId does not match any indexed solution, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request rate limits are exceeded.

topicId.description: The unique topic ID of the solution to retrieve. This ID can be obtained from the 'topicId' field in the response of the 'list_problem_solutions' tool. Format is typically a string of numbers and letters that uniquely identifies the solution in LeetCode's database.

tool_schemas.name: list_daily_challenges
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached Daily Challenge rows in descending challenge_date order, optionally filtered by date range and status. Returns a paginated page of daily challenge metadata (and problem_id) but does not return a different date’s challenge when a date filter is used. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid dates/ranges or invalid pagination values, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request rate limits are exceeded.

fromDate.description: Optional inclusive start ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to filter by challenge_date.

toDate.description: Optional inclusive end ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to filter by challenge_date.

limit.description: Maximum number of daily challenges to return.

offset.description: Number of daily challenges to skip before returning results.

tool_schemas.name: refresh_problem
tool_schemas.description: Forces a cache refresh of a single problem by titleSlug from the upstream read APIs and upserts the cached row. Optionally updates lifecycle status to an allowed value as part of the same mutation. Returns the refreshed problem record. Refuses invalid status transitions, refuses updates that would violate foreign key integrity, raises NOT_FOUND if the upstream problem cannot be resolved, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request rate limits are exceeded.

titleSlug.description: The URL slug/identifier of the problem to refresh (e.g., 'two-sum').

status.description: Optional new lifecycle status to set; must be a valid transition from the current status.

force.description: If true, refreshes even if source_last_synced_at is recent; otherwise may short-circuit using cache freshness rules.

metadata.name: LeetCode
metadata.description: This backend mirrors key LeetCode read APIs by caching problem metadata/content, daily challenge selection, user profiles and activity, and community solution topics/articles. Main workflows: periodically ingest/update problems and daily challenge, fetch user profile + submissions + contest ranking
